articles.title: Oppo Reno 14 Pro vs Nothing Phone 3: 7 big and small differences you should know between the two latest smartphones
articles.description: Oppo and Nothing recently launched their latest smartphones in India—each targeting different price points. Here are 7 major and minor differences to help you decide which one fits your needs better.
